summary.text: Douglas Thomas is the Republican candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 72, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Cynthia Soma-Hernandez.
A trucking company owner, Thomas previously served in the Maine House from 2004 to 2010 and in the Maine State Senate from 2010 to 2014.

paragraphs.text: Thomas is the owner of Doug Thomas Trucking, according to Ballotpedia.
Thomas represented the Maine House from 2004 to 2010 and Maine State Senate District 27 from 2010 to 2014.
Thomas lost the Republican primary for Maine State Senate District 4 in 2020 and finished third in the 2022 general election for Senate District 5, which Russell Black won.
Thomas advanced from the Republican primary for House District 72 on June 9, 2026.
